run_openevolve_evaluation: run the OpenEvolve adapter against lm-eval tasks like gsm8k or boolq using the CLI
generate_answers_with_openevolve: generate answers for prompts by running the OpenEvolve pipeline subprocess and reading the best output
generate_until_with_stop_sequences: generate answers until stop sequences are found using the generate_until method with post-trimming
configure_openevolve_adapter: configure the OpenEvolve LM adapter with an init file, evaluator file, config, and iteration count
review_openevolve_class: review the OpenEvolve class that implements the lm-evaluation-harness LM interface for generation-only tasks
